name: Indiana University Indianapolis (IU Indy)
tuition_note: In-state (Indiana resident) tuition & mandatory fees $10,760 and Housing and Food (combined room+board) $14,006 for the 2026-27 academic year, from official IU Indianapolis cost of attendance page (indianapolis.iu.edu/cost-aid/cost-of-attendance/). Room-only figure is not published separately; page uses 'Housing and Food' as a combined category.
